_ghi_nguon: Bản Hy Lạp: trong trận Heracles đánh Hydra (kỳ công thứ hai), Hera sai con cua khổng lồ Karkinos tới, Heracles giẫm nát nó, Hera đặt nó lên trời (trang Cancer (mythology) — Wikipedia chuyển từ Karkinos — và Lernaean Hydra).

moc.chu: Once he reached the swamp, Heracles confronted the Hydra.
He tried to cut off the heads of the beast but for every one he cut off, two more grew.
Seeing that Heracles was winning the struggle, Hera sent a giant crab to distract him.
He crushed it under his mighty foot.
The Hydra's one immortal head was cut off with a golden sword given to Heracles by Athena.
Heracles kills the Crab, who is rewarded for his efforts by Hera turning him into the constellation of Cancer.

site: Cancer wants safety, for itself and for whoever it has claimed.

hydra.mo_ta: The Lernaean Hydra, a huge swamp serpent monster with many (seven) snake heads on long necks, dark green scales, yellow eyes, dripping venom

cua.mo_ta: Karkinos, a giant red-orange crab with big raised claws and stalk eyes, wet shiny shell

hera.mo_ta: Hera, queen of the Greek gods, regal and stern, tall golden crown, white and royal-blue robes, a peacock-feather fan
